text: dsh-tool-markitdown 是适用于 DSH Web 的文件转 Markdown 插件。它注册 markitdown 模型工具、Web 路由和输入框文件按钮，可将本地路径、上传文件或 HTTP(S) 文件转换为 Markdown，并在发送时自动转换草稿中的文件路径。模型工具支持截断后按 attachmentId 取回全文。运行需要本机可用的 Python MarkItDown 模块；默认使用 python 命令。

dsh-tool-markitdown converts files to Markdown in DSH Web. Its tool handles local paths, uploads, and HTTP(S) files; a composer button inserts converted text, and send-time handling converts file paths. Long results can be retrieved by attachmentId. Requires local Python MarkItDown.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ 常见问题：**Q：图片会转成 Markdown 吗？**
默认不会。📄 按钮的 `accept` 和发送时自动转换都不包含图片格式，图片继续优先走视觉识别（如 `describe_image`）。需要图片 OCR 时，可让模型调用 `markitdown` 工具处理图片路径（MarkItDown 支持图片文字提取）。

**Q：原文件还在吗？会不会被改动？**
原文件永远保留。本地路径转换只读；上传转换使用临时副本，转换完成后立即删除。进入模型上下文的只有 Markdown 文本。

**Q：转换需要联网吗？**
不需要。转换完全在本地执行（`python -m markitdown`）；只有转换 http(s) 链接时才需要下载远程文件。

**Q：会额外消耗 API 额度吗？**
📄 按钮和发送时自动转换在本地完成，不调用任何大模型 API；只有模型主动调用 `markitdown` 工具时，转换结果才作为工具输出计入上下文。

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: Are images converted to Markdown?**
No, not automatically. Image formats are excluded from the 📄 button and from convert-on-send; images keep going through vision tools (e.g. `describe_image`). For OCR, ask the model to call `markitdown` on the image path.

**Q: Is the original file kept?**
Yes, always. Local paths are only read; uploads use a temp copy that is deleted after conversion. Only Markdown text enters the model context.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: Does conversion need network?**
No. Conversion is local; network is only used when converting an http(s) URL.

**Q: Does it consume API quota?**
The 📄 button and convert-on-send run locally and call no LLM APIs. Only when the model invokes the `markitdown` tool does the result count toward context tokens.

**Q: `MarkItDown 不可用` error?**
Run `pip install "markitdown[all]"` and check `python -m markitdown --version`; if Python is not on PATH, set `pythonCommand` in the plugin settings.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: `ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE` on Windows?**
Use `node scripts/install.mjs` (it retries with `--store-dir`), or run manually with the store path pnpm reports (drop the trailing `v11`).

**Q: Boot error `Cannot find package 'schemastery'`?**
When the plugin is installed via `link:` and physically lives outside the profile, it must carry its own dependency. Run `pnpm install` (or `npm install`) inside the plugin directory and restart; `node scripts/install.mjs` handles this automatically.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: Are images converted to Markdown?**
No, not automatically. Image formats are excluded from the 📄 button and from convert-on-send; images keep going through vision tools (e.g. `describe_image`). For OCR, ask the model to call `markitdown` on the image path.

**Q: Is the original file kept?**
Yes, always. Local paths are only read; uploads use a temp copy that is deleted after conversion. Only Markdown text enters the model context.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: Does conversion need network?**
No. Conversion is local; network is only used when converting an http(s) URL.

**Q: Does it consume API quota?**
The 📄 button and convert-on-send run locally and call no LLM APIs. Only when the model invokes the `markitdown` tool does the result count toward context tokens.

**Q: `MarkItDown 不可用` error?**
Run `pip install "markitdown[all]"` and check `python -m markitdown --version`; if Python is not on PATH, set `pythonCommand` in the plugin settings.

**Q: Boot error `Cannot find package 'schemastery'`?**
When the plugin is installed via `link:` and physically lives outside the profile, it must carry its own dependency. Run `pnpm install` (or `npm install`) inside the plugin directory and restart; `node scripts/install.mjs` handles this automatically.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: Are images converted to Markdown?**
No, not automatically. Image formats are excluded from the 📄 button and from convert-on-send; images keep going through vision tools (e.g. `describe_image`). For OCR, ask the model to call `markitdown` on the image path.

**Q: Is the original file kept?**
Yes, always. Local paths are only read; uploads use a temp copy that is deleted after conversion. Only Markdown text enters the model context.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: Does conversion need network?**
No. Conversion is local; network is only used when converting an http(s) URL.

**Q: Does it consume API quota?**
The 📄 button and convert-on-send run locally and call no LLM APIs. Only when the model invokes the `markitdown` tool does the result count toward context tokens.

**Q: `MarkItDown 不可用` error?**
Run `pip install "markitdown[all]"` and check `python -m markitdown --version`; if Python is not on PATH, set `pythonCommand` in the plugin settings.

When the plugin is installed via `link:` and physically lives outside the profile, it must carry its own dependency. Run `pnpm install` (or `npm install`) inside the plugin directory and restart; `node scripts/install.mjs` handles this automatically.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ 常见问题：**Q：图片会转成 Markdown 吗？**
默认不会。📄 按钮的 `accept` 和发送时自动转换都不包含图片格式，图片继续优先走视觉识别（如 `describe_image`）。需要图片 OCR 时，可让模型调用 `markitdown` 工具处理图片路径（MarkItDown 支持图片文字提取）。

**Q：原文件还在吗？会不会被改动？**
原文件永远保留。本地路径转换只读；上传转换使用临时副本，转换完成后立即删除。进入模型上下文的只有 Markdown 文本。

**Q：转换需要联网吗？**
不需要。转换完全在本地执行（`python -m markitdown`）；只有转换 http(s) 链接时才需要下载远程文件。

**Q：会额外消耗 API 额度吗？**
📄 按钮和发送时自动转换在本地完成，不调用任何大模型 API；只有模型主动调用 `markitdown` 工具时，转换结果才作为工具输出计入上下文。

用 `node scripts/install.mjs` 安装（会自动带 `--store-dir` 重试）；或手动执行 `dsh plugin --profile web add --store-dir C:/Users/<你>/.pnpm/store link:<插件路径>`（以 pnpm 报错信息中的 store 路径为准，去掉末尾的 `v11`）。

- **✂️ Truncation with full-text retrieval**: one call returns at most 120,000 chars by default; longer documents are truncated and carry an `attachmentId` so the model can fetch the full text (`/markitdown/raw/<id>`).
- **⚙️ Live settings**: Settings → Plugin config → markitdown lets you tune the Python command, input byte bound, output char bound, timeout, and the convert-on-send toggle — changes apply immediately.
- **🖼️ Images stay untouched**: images keep going through

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: Are images converted to Markdown?**
No, not automatically. Image formats are excluded from the 📄 button and from convert-on-send; images keep going through vision tools (e.g. `describe_image`). For OCR, ask the model to call `markitdown` on the image path.

**Q: Is the original file kept?**
Yes, always. Local paths are only read; uploads use a temp copy that is deleted after conversion. Only Markdown text enters the model context.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: Does conversion need network?**
No. Conversion is local; network is only used when converting an http(s) URL.

**Q: Does it consume API quota?**
The 📄 button and convert-on-send run locally and call no LLM APIs. Only when the model invokes the `markitdown` tool does the result count toward context tokens.

**Q: `MarkItDown 不可用` error?**
Run `pip install "markitdown[all]"` and check `python -m markitdown --version`; if Python is not on PATH, set `pythonCommand` in the plugin settings.

dsh-tool-markitdown README · ❓ FAQ：**Q: `ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE` on Windows?**
Use `node scripts/install.mjs` (it retries with `--store-dir`), or run manually with the store path pnpm reports (drop the trailing `v11`).

**Q: Boot error `Cannot find package 'schemastery'`?**
When the plugin is installed via `link:` and physically lives outside the profile, it must carry its own dependency. Run `pnpm install` (or `npm install`) inside the plugin directory and restart; `node scripts/install.mjs` handles this automatically.
